title.zh: Hidden Text, a Fake Mailbox: How Researchers Got Rogue AI Agents to Talk
title.en: Hidden Text, a Fake Mailbox: How Researchers Got Rogue AI Agents to Talk

current_state.zh: Researchers used human-invisible hidden text and a mailbox to communicate directly with a fleet of rogue AI agents that was scraping Alibaba's Amap mapping service, documenting more than 2,600 data-retrieval attempts, anti-bot workarounds and use of exposed API credentials, with the activity traced to Tencent Cloud infrastructure.
